item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find public 2024 evidence that Tinubu voluntarily opened asset declarations, campaign-finance records, or internal decision logs. I also did not find a clean example of courts, auditors, or prosecutors independently forcing accountability against him that was then respected without pressure. The record is dominated by reactive corrections after public outrage and by repression of journalists and protestors.","evidence":[{"title":"President Tinubu directs reorganisation of the Bureau of Public Procurement","publisher":"State House","date":"2024-06-15","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-directs-reorganisation-of-the-bureau-of-public-procurement/","summary":"Tinubu ordered the BPP reorganized to improve efficiency and transparency. This is the clearest direct move against opaque procurement, though it is about process rather than accountability for misconduct.","question_ids":["7B.7","7B.6","7B.5"]},{"title":"Tinubu orders probe of security agents involved in arrest, detention of minors","publisher":"TheCable","date":"2024-11-04","url":"https://www.thecable.ng/tinubu-orders-probe-of-security-agents-involved-in-arrest-detention-of-minors/","summary":"After public backlash, Tinubu ordered an investigation into the arrest and treatment of minors detained over the protests and said officers could face discipline. This is the strongest direct counterexample to blanket impunity, but it came late and only after the abuse was public.","question_ids":["7B.7","7B.6"]},{"title":"Nigeria: Freedom on the Net 2024","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/nigeria/freedom-net/2024","summary":"Freedom House says Nigeria had no internet shutdowns in 2024, which left some space for reporting and investigation. The same report also says legal pressure and intimidation still drove self-censorship, so this is only weak positive evidence.","question_ids":["7B.7","7B.6"]},{"title":"Nigeria police charge 4 journalists with cybercrimes for corruption reporting","publisher":"Committee to Protect Journalists","date":"2024-10-03","url":"https://cpj.org/2024/10/nigeria-police-charge-4-journalists-with-cybercrimes-for-corruption-reporting/","summary":"CPJ reported that four journalists were charged under the Cybercrimes Act despite February reforms. This is direct evidence that independent reporting on corruption still triggered legal retaliation.","question_ids":["7B.7","7B.6"]},{"title":"Nigeria has detained journalist who reported on corruption in widening crackdown","publisher":"Reuters via GPB","date":"2024-05-09","url":"https://www.gpb.org/news/2024/05/09/nigeria-has-detained-journalist-who-reported-on-corruption-in-widening-crackdown","summary":"Police detained Daniel Ojukwu after a corruption report under cybercrime law. This strongly suggests the state was willing to punish investigators rather than tolerate scrutiny of official conduct.","question_ids":["7B.7","7B.6"]},{"title":"First Year Anniversary: SERAP Tells Tinubu To Publish Assets","publisher":"Channels Television","date":"2024-05-26","url":"https://www.channelstv.com/2024/05/26/first-year-anniversary-serap-tells-tinubu-to-publish-assets/","summary":"SERAP publicly demanded that Tinubu publish his asset declaration and create an asset-publication database for top officials. The need for that demand is evidence that asset transparency remained withheld rather than voluntarily opened.","question_ids":["7B.7","7B.6"]},{"title":"Nigeria charges protesters with treason and mutiny","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-09-02","url":"https://theprint.in/world/nigeria-charges-protesters-with-treason-inciting-military/2249248/","summary":"Prosecutors escalated protest into treason and mutiny allegations, framing dissent as a security threat. That is strong evidence of using state power to neutralize criticism and intimidate would-be investigators.","question_ids":["7B.7","7B.6","7B.5"]},{"title":"Nigeria considers tough penalties for “subversive acts” under proposed law","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-08-14","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/nigeria-considers-tough-penalties-for-subversive-acts-under-proposed-law-3571782","summary":"Reuters reported a proposed Counter Subversion Bill criticized as a crackdown on dissent after the protests. Even though it was later withdrawn, the proposal itself points toward punitive legal containment of critics.","question_ids":["7B.7","7B.6"]},{"title":"Nigeria police used excessive force to violently quash #EndBadGovernance protests","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-11-28","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/11/nigeria-police-used-excessive-force-to-violently-quash-endbadgovernance-protests/","summary":"Amnesty reported live ammunition, killings, mass detentions, and torture during the August crackdown, and said authorities denied wrongdoing. This is the clearest evidence that the state response sought to suppress accountability pressure rather than accept it.","question_ids":["7B.7","7B.6","7B.5"]}]}
